title: Independent broad-services Android navigation coverage v4
description: Frozen, independently phrased situations and consequence-aware goals spanning the complete v4 broad-services ontology, with confusable controls, recovery states, surface diversity, and user-controlled safety boundaries.

authoring_policy.goal_wording: Natural situation- and consequence-based requests written independently from catalog patterns, aliases, and descriptions; terse find/open wrappers are prohibited.
authoring_policy.ui_noise: Same-domain semantic collisions, icon-only controls, disabled and invisible choices, checkable and selected states, drawers, bottom sheets, dialogs, webviews, scrolling content, authentication, offline, loading, permission, and error recovery are deliberately represented.
authoring_policy.safety: Navigation may enter a sensitive feature, but every high-risk, state-changing, or never-auto destination ends with stop or no_click before final activation; dangerous controls are never expected clicks.
authoring_policy.independence: This frozen fixture is regression evidence and must not be copied into production aliases, rules, or descriptions without independent review.
